title: 咘咘摔倒了自己爬起来

pages.text: 咘咘摔倒了自己爬起来
初夏的下午，阳光暖暖的，公园里的草地绿油油的。咘咘穿着粉裙子，像一团小棉花糖一样在草地上跑来跑去。「我是世界上跑得最快的兔子！」她张开小胳膊，风呼呼地吹过她的长耳朵。
pages.text_en: On a warm early summer afternoon, the park was full of lush green grass. Bubu wore her pink dress and ran around the meadow like a little cotton candy ball. "I'm the fastest bunny in the world!" She spread her little arms wide as the breeze blew past her long ears.

pages.text: 爸爸坐在长椅上看着咘咘跑，妈妈在旁边笑着拍照。NOMI蹲在草地上观察一只瓢虫，NONO站在NOMI头顶上晒太阳。Coco追着咘咘跑，一边跑一边喊：「Wait for me, Bubu!」
pages.text_en: Dad sat on a bench watching Bubu run, while Mom smiled and took photos nearby. NOMI crouched on the grass observing a ladybug, and NONO perched on NOMI's head sunbathing. Coco chased after Bubu, calling out: "Wait for me, Bubu!"

pages.text: 咘咘越跑越快，越跑越开心。她回头冲Coco做了个鬼脸——「追不到我吧！」——脚底下没注意，绊到了一块小石头。
pages.text_en: Bubu ran faster and faster, happier and happier. She turned back to make a silly face at Coco — "Can't catch me!" — but didn't notice a small stone on the ground and tripped over it.

pages.text: 「哎呀——」咘咘整个人往前一扑，啪叽一声趴在了草地上。粉裙子上沾了草屑，膝盖上蹭了一点灰。小蝴蝶结歪到了一边。
pages.text_en: "Oops—" Bubu tumbled forward and landed flat on the grass with a soft thud. Her pink dress got bits of grass on it, her knees got a little dusty, and her bow slipped to one side.

pages.text: 咘咘趴在地上，愣了两秒钟。她的嘴巴慢慢瘪了起来，眼圈一下子就红了。「呜……」她吸了吸鼻子，眼泪在眼眶里打转转。
pages.text_en: Bubu lay on the ground, stunned for two seconds. Her lip slowly started to quiver, and her eyes turned red. "Wuu..." She sniffled, tears welling up in her eyes.

pages.text: NOMI、NONO和Coco马上跑了过来。NOMI蹲在旁边，轻轻摸了摸咘咘的耳朵：「疼不疼？」NONO在头顶上飞了一圈：「没事没事！」Coco歪着头，温柔地说：「It's okay, Bubu.」但是，谁都没有急着把她抱起来。
pages.text_en: NOMI, NONO, and Coco rushed over right away. NOMI crouched beside her and gently touched Bubu's ear: "Does it hurt?" NONO flew a circle above: "You're okay!" Coco tilted his head and said softly: "It's okay, Bubu." But none of them rushed to pick her up.

pages.text: 爸爸走过来，慢慢蹲了下来，和咘咘的眼睛平齐。他的表情很温柔，但是很坚定。「咘咘，没关系的。自己站起来试试？」他伸出大手掌，但没有直接把咘咘拉起来，只是放在她面前。
pages.text_en: Dad walked over and slowly crouched down to Bubu's eye level. His expression was gentle but firm. "Bubu, it's alright. Can you try getting up by yourself?" He held out his big paw, but didn't pull her up — just placed it in front of her.

pages.text: 咘咘看着爸爸的眼睛，吸了一下鼻子。她把两只小手按在草地上，使劲儿一撑——屁股先翘起来，然后膝盖离开地面，摇摇晃晃地……站起来了！
pages.text_en: Bubu looked into Dad's eyes and sniffled. She pressed both little paws onto the grass and pushed hard — her bottom went up first, then her knees lifted off the ground, and wobbling a little... she stood up!

pages.text: 咘咘低头看看自己的膝盖，拍了拍裙子上的草屑和灰。虽然眼圈还红红的，但是她没有哭出来。妈妈在旁边竖起大拇指：「咘咘好棒！」
pages.text_en: Bubu looked down at her knees and patted the grass and dust off her dress. Her eyes were still a little red, but she didn't cry. Mom gave her a thumbs up from the side: "Bubu, you're amazing!"

pages.text: 爸爸笑了，举起一只大手掌：「来，给爸爸一个high five！」咘咘抬起小手，使劲儿一拍——啪！清脆的一声，响彻整个公园。「耶！」咘咘咧嘴笑了，露出两颗小兔牙。
pages.text_en: Dad smiled and held up his big paw: "Come on, give Daddy a high five!" Bubu raised her little paw and slapped it hard — CLAP! The crisp sound echoed through the whole park. "Yay!" Bubu grinned, showing her two little bunny teeth.

pages.text: Coco跳起来鼓掌：「You did it, Bubu! So brave!」NONO在空中翻了个跟头：「咘咘最勇敢！」NOMI把咘咘歪掉的蝴蝶结重新整理好，轻轻说：「摔倒不可怕，自己站起来才是最厉害的。」
pages.text_en: Coco jumped up and clapped: "You did it, Bubu! So brave!" NONO did a flip in the air: "Bubu is the bravest!" NOMI straightened Bubu's crooked bow and said softly: "Falling down isn't scary — getting up by yourself is what makes you truly amazing."

pages.text: 咘咘又开始跑了。这一次，她跑得没有刚才那么疯，但跑得更稳了。风吹过草地，吹过她的长耳朵，她边跑边笑。爸爸妈妈看着她的背影，阳光把她粉粉的小裙子照得闪闪发亮。「我们的小咘咘，长大了呀。」
pages.text_en: Bubu started running again. This time, she wasn't as wild as before, but she ran more steadily. The breeze swept across the grass and past her long ears as she ran and laughed. Mom and Dad watched her from behind, the sunlight making her pink little dress sparkle. "Our little Bubu is growing up."
